operation_details.item: The user's Deal A is in the negotiation stage.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Morning! Just finished updating the pipeline before the team sync. Feels good to have everything in one view again.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Morning! That's great discipline. What's looking most active right now? Any deals moving faster than expected?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Deal A is definitely the one to watch — we're in the negotiation stage now, so it's getting down to the wire. Lots of back-and-forth on terms.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Negotiation is a good spot to be in. Are the other deals staying on track too?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yeah, Deal B is sitting in the proposal stage, and Deal C is still in discovery. They're moving at a normal pace, not as urgent.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That's a solid spread — a mix of near-term and longer-term opportunities. Do you find the pipeline view helps you prioritize where to spend your time each week?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Absolutely. Since every deal stage is tracked in the pipeline view, I can quickly see which ones need a push and which can wait. It keeps me from getting distracted.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Makes sense. Keeping that discipline is half the battle. Well, good luck with Deal A — hope the negotiations wrap up soon!

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only the stage of Deal A, while keeping the stages for Deals B and C and the pipeline tracking.
